d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To portion meals for our customers using our technology - ensuring all meals are ready and packaged to be dispatched on time for the deliveries, while adhering to high standards of hygiene, quality & consistency.
q: Must have at least 1-2 years of dispatching experience in the food industry, preferably in fast food
Holds very high standards in hygiene practices in a kitchen facility
Must be a proficient communicator in English
Knowledge in food safety is a plus
Enthusiastic and values respect for everyone around them
r: Portioning the components for every meal for every specific customer on time before deliveries go out
Communicating with the drivers & Customer Experience team to ensure a top notch customer experience
Maintaining proper hygiene standards in the kitchen
Ensuring any last minute changes are carried out with our high standards

d: Visioneers is seeking a highly strategic, commercially minded, and creative Head of Marketing to lead the marketing strategy, brand positioning, media investment, sponsorship initiatives, and audience development of one of its media and broadcasting entities.

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for establishing and strengthening the organization's brand identity, maximizing market visibility, and developing impactful marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, audience acquisition, viewership, and business growth.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with exceptional branding instincts, extensive industry knowledge, established media relationships, and a deep understanding of audience behavior, market trends, and the evolving broadcasting landscape.

The role requires a leader who can translate audience intelligence into actionable marketing strategies while ensuring brand excellence, consistency, and attention to detail across every internal and external touchpoint.
q: Own the organization's overall brand identity, ensuring consistency, relevance, quality, and excellence across all touchpoints.
Establish and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines governing visual identity, tone of voice, messaging, design, and brand applications.
Oversee the consistent application of branding across television, digital platforms, corporate communications, events, promotional materials, and physical environments.

Ensure meticulous attention to detail across all branded assets, including broadcast microphone branding, studio branding, signage, merchandise, corporate gifts, stationery, branded mugs, packaging, and promotional displays.
Provide strategic direction on product selection, material quality, design, logo placement, visual presentation, and the overall brand experience.
Ensure every physical and digital representation of the organization reinforces its positioning, credibility, and desired public image.
Evaluate creative concepts, campaign visuals, promotional materials, and brand activations to ensure alignment with the organization's identity and quality standards.

Safeguard brand reputation by ensuring all marketing communications, creative assets, and public-facing initiatives comply with applicable governmental, regulatory, cultural, and corporate guidelines.
Establish effective brand approval processes and quality control mechanisms across departments and markets.
Develop and oversee the organization's sponsorship and event participation strategy in alignment with brand positioning and business objectives.
Identify high-impact sponsorship opportunities, strategic events, industry conferences, cultural initiatives, and partnerships that enhance brand visibility and credibility.
Evaluate potential sponsorship opportunities based on audience relevance, strategic alignment, reputation, exposure, commercial value, and expected return on investment.
Determine which events the organization should sponsor, participate in, partner with, or independently organize.
Define how the brand should be represented at sponsored events, including sponsorship packages, brand placement, experiential activations, promotional materials, and audience engagement initiatives.
Oversee sponsorship negotiations, contractual deliverables, activation strategies, and post-event performance evaluations.
Ensure sponsorship investments deliver meaningful exposure and measurable value beyond traditional logo placement.
Build and maintain relationships with event organizers, strategic partners, government entities, industry associations, and relevant stakeholders.
Oversee the Sponsorship Manager's activities, ensuring alignment with the overall marketing and brand strategy.
Maintain strong professional relationships with major digital platforms, media networks, advertising partners, agencies, and relevant industry representatives.
Stay abreast of emerging marketing trends, platform innovations, successful brand campaigns, and evolving audience expectations.
Benchmark against leading regional and international broadcasters, media organizations, and successful consumer brands.
Identify innovative marketing approaches, technologies, partnerships, and brand experiences that strengthen market differentiation.
Advise senior leadership on emerging opportunities, industry developments, reputational considerations, and evolving marketing best practices.
Assess the relevance of new trends and innovations, ensuring their adoption is purposeful and aligned with the organization's brand identity rather than driven solely by popularity.
Foster a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the marketing function.
Oversee the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, promotional initiatives, channel campaigns, and programming launches.
Collaborate closely with digital, production, programming, editorial, communications, and commercial teams to ensure consistent messaging and strategic alignment.
Develop compelling promotional strategies that maximize awareness and viewership of television programming and digital content.
Manage external creative agencies, media agencies, production partners, suppliers, and marketing service providers.
Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with established quality standards.
Establish effective marketing workflows, campaign approval processes, and performance reporting mechanisms.
Lead, develop, and manage the marketing team, including the Sponsorship Manager and remotely based Marketing Coordinator.
Establish clear departmental priorities, individual responsibilities, performance objectives, and accountability frameworks.
r: Develop and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with the organization's business, broadcasting, editorial, and commercial objectives.
Establish a distinctive, competitive, and recognizable brand positioning across regional and international markets.
Develop annual marketing plans, campaign strategies, budgets, and measurable performance objectives.
Identify opportunities to strengthen brand awareness, credibility, market relevance, and audience perception.
Monitor competitor positioning, industry developments, consumer behavior, and emerging marketing trends.
Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership on initiatives that enhance brand equity, visibility, and market competitiveness.
Ensure marketing strategies are relevant to different audiences, markets, and cultural environments.
Lead and oversee all media planning, buying, negotiation, and investment activities across relevant advertising channels.
Develop integrated media strategies spanning television, digital, social media, outdoor advertising, radio, print, and other relevant platforms.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with media agencies, media owners, advertising partners, digital platforms, and industry stakeholders.
Negotiate competitive media rates, placements, partnerships, and advertising opportunities to maximize the return on marketing investment.
Determine the most effective media mix, campaign timing, audience targeting, and budget allocation.
Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize media investments based on measurable outcomes.
Evaluate agency and media partner performance, ensuring accountability, transparency, and value for investment.
Identify innovative advertising opportunities and emerging media channels that can enhance brand visibility and audience reach.

Leverage Ipsos and other recognized audience measurement, media monitoring, and market research tools to evaluate television viewership, audience demographics, consumption patterns, and market performance.
Analyze and interpret audience ratings, reach, market share, viewing behavior, competitor performance, and brand perception data.
Translate complex audience and market data into clear, actionable marketing strategies and recommendations.
Identify audience segments, growth opportunities, market gaps, and shifts in consumer behavior.
Collaborate with programming, digital, editorial, and production teams to ensure audience insights inform promotional strategies and business decisions.
Develop regular performance reports and executive presentations highlighting key findings, opportunities, risks, and recommended actions.
Establish data-driven marketing objectives and ensure marketing initiatives contribute to measurable audience and viewership growth.
Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns against audience acquisition, brand awareness, and business objectives.

A registered nurse at Baptist Health is accountable for utilizing the nursing process and the training provided by Baptist Health to provide safe, therapeutic, and compassionate patient care. The nurse is expected to demonstrate clinical competence and critical thinking. The RN is responsible to know and understand the policies and processes of the department and the requirements of the organization and use them in a unified workflow with the rest of the healthcare team to create an exceptional patient experience with the best possible outcomes.

A new RN graduate from an accredited nursing program or Registered Nurse in good standing, and licensed to practice in the state of Arkansas. BSN preferred. Applies basic knowledge and skills to meet standard of care. Is able to practice as a full partner of an interdisciplinary team. RN that is not actively participating in the Clinical Nurse Advancement Program. Healthcare CPR required, some areas may require ACLS, PALS and/or NALS - training is provided. Specialty units require and will provide specific specialty education.
This job will be authorized 72.00 hours bi-weekly.
